data.definitions:
- **Arrival:** inferred from the trip-update feed. A feed lists the stops a vehicle has not served yet; when a stop drops off the list while the trip is still reported, the prediction in the last snapshot that listed it is taken as the arrival time.
- **Counted stops:** intermediate stops of trips matched to the timetable. First stops (the feed echoes the timetable there) and last stops (the trip simply leaves the feed) are excluded; stops reported by several vehicles at once are excluded as ambiguous.
- **On time:** delay between −60 s and +300 s; delay = inferred arrival − scheduled arrival.
- **Route ranking:** route-hours with at least 30 arrivals, weighted by arrivals.
- **Bus last stops** are measured separately from GPS positions and are not part of these numbers.
